verdict.rationale: Elicit documents first-party background features. Alerts monitor for new relevant papers and email you, and a newer Routine feature 'can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis', including filtering, updating an artifact or writing a summary. That is genuine autonomous automation, but it rests on a single thin mention on a legacy Alerts page. missing for 10: dedicated Routines documentation covering setup, scheduling cadence and triggers, limits on what Routines can do, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they run reliably in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: A Routine can act on what it finds and hand you a finished analysis: it can filter on criteria an Alert couldn't, update an artifact, or write the summary
Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.
Alerts keep you up to date on the latest research about topics that are relevant to you, ready to add to your Library for future use.
